[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
He was the son of [[Glasgow-3920|Patrick Glasgow]]. He passed away in 1738.
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-3920]] is assessed at 98% (proved). The Kilclone memorial names William among James’s brothers and Patrick’s sons. His queried age about 7 affects calculated birth only; Patrick’s identity is fixed by the same inscription and 1754 death.

Memorial father-son statement; William’s age query and c 1720 field are separate from the named parent.

Next useful test: Inspect stone or 1892 printed entry for queried age and exact relational wording.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-3926 Association for the Preservation of the Memorials of the Dead in Ireland,]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
